answer: Reputation-weighted task routing. Each identity starts at a fixed vertex value; successful tasks raise it, verified failures lower it, and rewards scale with it. New identities enter a grove of low-value queues, so cloning yields little routing. A lantern audit samples completed work, slashing the score and payout of any clone caught. Attacker cost: each fake identity needs sustained real work to reach useful trust, making N clones cost N times the honest effort while honest agents keep their gains.
